```{r}
# press -------------------------------------------------------------------
wb <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(filepath)
use_openxlsx <- function(filename = filepath, sheet) {
  # wb <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(filename)
  # map(wb$sheet_names, ~ openxlsx::readWorkbook(wb, .x))
  openxlsx::readWorkbook(wb, sheet, cols = 1:5, skipEmptyRows = FALSE)
}

use_readxl <- function(filename = filepath, sheet) {
  # readxl::excel_sheets(filename) |> map(~ readxl::read_excel(filename, .x))
  readxl::read_excel(filename, sheet, range = cellranger::cell_cols(1:5))
}

bm <- bench::press(
  sheet = readxl::excel_sheets(filepath),
  bench::mark(
    use_openxlsx(sheet = sheet),
    use_readxl(sheet = sheet),
    check = FALSE
  )
)
bench::mark(wb <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook(filepath))
bm |> group_by(expression) |> summarise(sum(median))
bm |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  aes(x = as_factor(expression |> as.character()), y = median, color = sheet, group = sheet) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  gghighlight::gghighlight(TRUE)

```
